companyContext: The LEGO Group is a Danish family-owned toy manufacturer founded in 1932, headquartered in Billund, Denmark. It is best known for the LEGO brick — an interlocking plastic construction system — and produces sets across original themes (City, Friends, Technic) and licensed properties (Star Wars, Marvel, Harry Potter, etc.). The name comes from the Danish phrase 'leg godt' meaning 'play well'.
brandContext: LEGO Marvel (LEGO Marvel Super Heroes) is the LEGO Group's licensed theme built around Marvel Comics and Marvel Studios characters, films and storylines. The 2026 lineup launches January 1 with six core sets — including 76334 Epic Battle: Spider-Man vs. Sandman, 76335 Spider-Man vs. Ghost Rider Motorcycle, 76336 Spider-Man Car vs. Venomized Wolverine, 76342 Spider-Man vs. Mysterio: The Daily Bugle, 76343 Epic Battle: Hulkbuster vs. The Hulk, and the flagship 18+ collector set 76344 Iron Man Mark 3 Collectors' Edition — followed by summer waves tied to Spider-Man: Brand New Day and Iron Man and His Awesome Friends, plus a returning buildable Groot (Ravager Jumpsuit) and an upcoming S.H.I.E.L.D. Helicarrier.

brandVision: To inspire and develop the builders of tomorrow by giving Marvel fans of every age a hands-on way to step into the Marvel Universe — recreating iconic battles, suiting up alongside Spider-Man, the Avengers and the Guardians of the Galaxy, and turning the joy of play into endlessly rebuildable stories. The 2026 LEGO Marvel direction blends bold, comic-book energy with collector-grade craftsmanship, bridging playsets for kids 4+ and premium 18+ display models like the Iron Man Mark 3.
brandValues: Imagination, creativity, fun, learning through play, quality and craftsmanship, family togetherness, and inclusivity — anchored by LEGO's motto 'only the best is good enough.' For LEGO Marvel specifically: heroism, courage, teamwork, the triumph of good over evil, and faithful storytelling that respects the Marvel source material while leaving room for every builder's own adventures.
